quests.title: The Thirst of the Buried City

find.text: A roadhouse tally-board: caravans listed with a tithe column. At the bottom, in a dead man's hand: 'Water owed: thirty-one wells. Paid: nine. Ask the goat.'

quests.desc: A roadhouse tally-board lists wells owed and wells paid to someone called 'the Herald', and tells me to ask the goat.
quests.pitch: The Silver Pilgrim's keeper says the caravan masters all pay a tithe in water to a man nobody has met.

objectives.text: Open the older well under the goat statue and take the shaft-map to Sentinel.
Take the water-merchant's debt-roll from Sentinel's harbour warehouse.
Find the pump under Volenfell's sand and recover its stop-key.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The water-tithe trail crosses Sentinel's harbour and three desert tombs to the glass-roofed shaft of a lost city.

quests.title: The Thirst of the Buried City (II)
quests.desc: The water-tithe trail crosses Sentinel's harbour and three desert tombs to the glass-roofed shaft of a lost city.
quests.pitch: The Silver Pilgrim's keeper says the caravan masters all pay a tithe in water to a man nobody has met.

objectives.text: Take the herald's seal from the Motalion niche and carry it to the throne-hall.
Press the herald's seal to the decree and open the sand door.
Reach the great cistern of the lost city and settle the water-tithe.

quests.outro: The lost city's great cistern drank deep for a moment and then, slowly, began to give. In the far oases the wells rose a hand's breadth. The dune-king's herald is a shadow now, and the account is closed.

quests.title: Reliefs That Remember Forward

find.text: A relief panel at the canyon mouth shows a scene half-carved: a dozen travellers on a staircase. The carving is fresh, and one of the faces looks very like yours.

quests.desc: A relief at the Valley of Scars shows a dozen travellers on a staircase, one of whom looks like me.
quests.pitch: A guide says the wall at the canyon mouth is being carved by nobody.

objectives.text: Compare the Valley of Scars rubbing with Elinhir's blank constellation.
Steal the arena-master's schedule from Dragonstar and see which panels remain.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The panel leads through a star-watchers' city, an arena and a sealed sphere to the stair of the spire.

quests.title: Reliefs That Remember Forward (II)
quests.desc: The panel leads through a star-watchers' city, an arena and a sealed sphere to the stair of the spire.
quests.pitch: A guide says the wall at the canyon mouth is being carved by nobody.

objectives.text: Open the archive's dusk seam and read the complete panel-roll.
Take the cult's key from the mirror-pool and climb the pinnacle.
Stand on the platform at dusk and decide what the last panel means.

quests.outro: At the top of the spire I stood on the last panel and understood it. It was not an ending but a stairway. I did not carve my own face; I stepped off it.

quests.title: The Gardener of Ahaleb

find.text: A rusted shackle lies on a sand-grave at the old slaver's cove. Scratched on the stone: 'Paid for, not freed. Ask who buys the debts.'

quests.desc: A shackle on a grave at Thrall Cove, with a note that a freedman's debts were bought rather than cancelled.
quests.pitch: A freedman at Thrall Cove says someone paid his debt and then asked him to plant a palm.

objectives.text: Trace the seed-jar manifest from Abah's Landing to Taneth.
Take the physician's unsigned certificates from Taneth to the lord's palace.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The debt-buyer's trail passes a palace and a walled bazaar and ends beneath a necropolis.

quests.title: The Gardener of Ahaleb (II)
quests.desc: The debt-buyer's trail passes a palace and a walled bazaar and ends beneath a necropolis.
quests.pitch: A freedman at Thrall Cove says someone paid his debt and then asked him to plant a palm.

objectives.text: Take the steward's ledger from the Hubalajad conservatory to the walled bazaar-city.
Trace the palm-bloom tincture from Rihad's spice gate to its source.
Enter the hidden oasis chamber and wake the gardeners.

quests.outro: In the garden under the skylights the palms bent towards me. I carried out one seed and left the gardener's ledger where his heirs could find it. The dead have waited long enough.

quests.title: The Sunken Clause

find.text: A lever behind a harbour crate opens a small cabinet. Inside, a ship's manifest for a sailing in the fifth year: 'Cargo: sealed. Destination: not recorded. Return: not expected.'

quests.desc: A hidden cabinet at the harbour gate holds a manifest for a ship that was never expected to return.
quests.pitch: The port clerk says every fifth year a ship leaves with a sealed cargo and nobody asks.

objectives.text: Take the shrine-token from Saintsport to the inn with the dragon's tail.
Win the lot at the Draggin Tale and take passage to the old harbour.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The ship's descendants gather at an inn with a dragon's tail over the door, and the cargo's trail ends at a ring of wind-carved arches.

quests.title: The Sunken Clause (II)
quests.desc: The ship's descendants gather at an inn with a dragon's tail over the door, and the cargo's trail ends at a ring of wind-carved arches.
quests.pitch: The port clerk says every fifth year a ship leaves with a sealed cargo and nobody asks.

objectives.text: Read the sealed clause in the Stros M'Kai lighthouse and follow the fifth-year ship.
Open the niche in the great arch and take the torn page of the ledger.

quests.outro: The wind sang through the arches and the torn page lay in my hands, a map of tides with a missing corner. The fifth-year ship is no longer owed. Someone, somewhere, will have to fill the corner.
